description: A true-crime-style horror retelling of the Eyeless Jack creepypasta.

A week after foreclosure, Mitch moves in with his brother Edwin. What begins as faint scratching at the bedroom window soon turns into midnight visits from a figure wearing a mouthless blue mask with empty, oozing eye sockets.
A Scroll Kaos paper-cutout horror story, told from Mitch's own memories. Watch until the very end.
